visual_scope: Actual release executable from exact extracted archive at 1280x800 Ultra, Mesa Intel ARL, OpenGLCore. Opt-in capture sets inspection state and moves fixed cameras; no native input or user-collected photos. Original unedited PNGs only.
visual_findings: Small varied stars and a dim Milky Way replace finite-distance bright square stars.
Initial equirectangular mapping produced radial polar distortion at heading 270; rejected image and manifest retained under Failed/.
Directional cubemap filtering removes that observed defect in the final heading 270 and zenith frames.
No visible discontinuity in sampled views across the +X/+Y face boundary. This does not prove every possible seam or temporal behavior.
Overall terrain, foreground modelling and reflection quality still lag the concept target; this pass only improves the ordinary night sky.
next_required: On unlocked Kubuntu, use fresh isolated profiles for active and passive chapter routes, inspect actual saved photos, restart the process, then collect a separate 120+ second performance run after 20 seconds warm-up. Keep Visual10 default until these pass.

delivery_visibility.action: No push, PR or visibility change. New code and evidence remain local.
